svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld on a flat table in this order, tacking everything first:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Rails on edge, parallel, 440 mm apart inside; cross members under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them; nose beam across their front ends. Check the diagonals agree

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Head tube held in a jig at 70 degrees, its bottom end 640 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: table plane under the wheels (470 mm above the rails' underside),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1410 mm ahead of the rails' rear ends, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Down tube between the nose beam and the head tube (sheet 103).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Dropouts on a dummy 135 mm axle, axle 77 mm above the rails' underside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 270 mm behind their rear ends; then the four stays.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. End caps, lugs, plates, tabs and nuts (sheet 105).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld in short runs, alternating sides, to limit distortion.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rails flat and parallel within 2 mm; head tube on the centre line

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: within 1 mm; rear axle square to the centre line; then paint.
